name: Setswana
orthography: South African and Botswana standard orthography (š, tš, optional ê ô)
notes: Broad phonemic transcription following the University of Botswana (2001) table as given in the Wikipedia article on Tswana, cross-checked with orthography2ipa tn.json and Epitran tsn-Latn.csv. espeak-ng's tn voice is not usable: it emits K for tlh and turns a word-final e into l.
g is the fricative χ (go bua /χʊ bua/) and kg the aspirated affricate kχʰ (kgosi).
Plain p t k ts tl tš are ejective; the ejective mark is left out because the spelling predicts it, and the aspirated series carries ʰ.
e and o are written ɪ ʊ and ê ô ɛ ɔ, as in the University of Botswana table; most texts leave the circumflex out, so plain e and o also stand for ɛ ɔ.
Tone is not written and is not transcribed.

rules.note: Velar nasal before k and clicks. ng is its own letter (ŋ).
